period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Profit and Loss Account for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2011" / "Balance Sheet as at 30 September 2011"). This copy is a multi-page scanned photocopy (visibly a physical scan with scan-line artifacts, no usable text layer) rather than a native-text PDF; figures were read visually from high-resolution page renders (page 5 for Solo Balance Sheet, page 6 for Solo Profit and Loss Account, out of 8 total pages). Per project convention the SOLO figures are used, not 'Consolidated' (page 1). Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 86,343.59m + Total equity 12,996.89m = Total assets 99,340.48m exactly; every P&L subtotal from Total operating income (5,034.66m) down to Net profit after tax (1,368.04m) reconciles exactly. Paid-up capital rose from BDT 3,888,547,200 (31-Mar-2011) to BDT 5,055,111,360 by this date, implying a rights/bonus share issue during Q2-Q3 2011 (consistent with the weighted-average EPS of 27.06 not exactly matching a simple period-end-shares calculation). Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in this primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap.
